title: Static statement classification manifest for recovered Production migration sources
source_provenance: Bodies previously verified byte-exact against Production migration ledger after removing exactly nine provenance-header lines.
splitter: Lexical semicolon splitter respecting SQL single/double quotes, line/block comments and PostgreSQL dollar-quoted bodies.
digest: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 statement bytes including the terminating semicolon where present.
rules: No SQL text is stored or executed by this manifest.
HTTP, pg_net, Cron, privileged identity seed and financial writes are excluded or synthetic-only.
GRANT/REVOKE entries are assertions only, not instructions to apply persistent ACL changes.

classification_notes.transaction_wrapper_strip_before_fixture: BEGIN/COMMIT wrappers are not replayed as standalone statements; any candidate unit must be re-authored into an explicit test transaction.
classification_notes.manual_review_dynamic_function_rewrite_b: DO blocks that inspect and rewrite existing trading function bodies are blocked until exact before/after definitions, preconditions and rollback behavior are independently reviewed. They are not executed by this manifest.
classification_notes.schema_or_function_candidate_dependency_: Candidate only; exact dependencies, owner, grants, RLS and synthetic prerequisites still require review before any disposable fixture use.
classification_notes.schema_metadata_comment_candidate: COMMENT metadata only; may be asserted in a fixture after object existence is established.
classification_notes.acl_assertion_only_no_persistent_replay: Record expected effective privileges in a fixture contract; do not apply GRANT/REVOKE to any persistent database.
classification_notes.excluded_external_http_or_queue: No pg_net HTTP invocation, queue read/write, queue snapshot or payload replay is allowed.
classification_notes.excluded_cron_side_effect: No pg_cron schedule creation, alteration, execution or removal is allowed.
classification_notes.excluded_privileged_identity_seed: Never replay a privileged identity assignment; use only a deterministic synthetic identity.
classification_notes.synthetic_financial_data_only: Only synthetic fixtures and rollback-scoped tests are allowed; no persistent balance/order/trade/reservation/transaction changes.
classification_notes.synthetic_data_only_rollback: Synthetic-only fixture DML, transaction-scoped and rolled back.
classification_notes.manual_review_unknown_fail_closed: Unknown statements block replay until individually classified.
